newsitem.title: USA: Clinton to speak on budget at 1115 EST (1515 GMT).
newsitem.headline: Clinton to speak on budget at 1115 EST (1515 GMT).

text.p: President Bill Clinton was to embrace a budget agreement with Congressional Republicans during an appearance in the White House Rose Garden on Friday, a spokesman said.
The spokesman said Clinton would issue a public statement on the deal at 11:15 EST (1515 GMT)
The compromise plan, hammered into final shape by White House officials and congressional Republican leaders on Thursday night, calls for a balanced budget by the year 2002.
It provides for $115 billion in Medicare savings over the next five years and a net $85 billion tax cut over the same period, including Clinton's $35 billion five-year tax credit for education.
"It continues our progress toward a balanced budget (and) continues the strong fundamentals that have created this very robust economy," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
